components.name: Observatory Pill Switch
components.description: Compact pill toggle supporting Hydro Cyan tracking semantics and Gilt Brass display semantics.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-flex; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-track { position: relative; width: 30px; height: 17px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1E2738; border: 1px solid #35425C; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-switch-track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: #CBD5E1; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background 0.16s ease; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track { background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.28); border-color: var(--obs-sky, #38BDF8); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track::after { transform: translateX(13px); background: var(--obs-sky, #38BDF8); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track { outline: 2px solid var(--obs-sky, #38BDF8); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Genshin Helper's Chrome Extension Control Center (`extension/popup.html`, `extension/popup.css`, `extension/popup.js`) is engineered as a nocturnal precision cartography instrument built for 2–3 second mid-game adjustments. Floating cleanly over dim-room gameplay and the HoYoLAB Interactive Map, the interface trades cramped vertical SaaS scrolling and decorative emoji clutter for a wide `520×580px` 2-column command deck framed by deep indigo slate panels, fine hairline instrument rulings, gilt-brass astrolabe accents, and celestial hydro-sky states.

Every surface earns its pixel budget through immediate scannability and single-click directness. Live engine state and Teyvat telemetry share one unified Horizon Strip above balanced functional columns, while connection health and the voluntary support trigger remain permanently anchored in a sticky bottom bar so scrolling never hides navigation or contribution links.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed `520×580px` zero-scroll Control and Tools viewports using a 2-column grid instead of a narrow scrolling popup.
Nocturnal observatory palette built around midnight indigo (`#0B0F19`), slate surfaces (`#121826`), and inset wells (`#0E131F`).
Crisp `1.75px`–`1.9px` monochrome inline SVG iconography across every control, strictly zero decorative emojis in popup chrome or feedback toasts.
Strict bilingual (`VI | EN`) parity with tabular lining numerals for live coordinates, audio percentages, and PIN codes.
Anchored slide-up popovers above a persistent `38px` footer so feedback banners and voluntary support QR drawers never cause layout shift.

rules.name: The Brass Reserve Rule
rules.body: Gilt brass (`#D9A441` / `#F3D28B`) marks active navigation, astrolabe framing, secondary quick-action chips, and the voluntary Support surface; reserve celestial cyan (`#38BDF8` / `#0369A1`) for primary navigation/tracking actions and live active switches.

rules.name: The Honest Semantic Rule
rules.body: Never paint decorative chrome emerald, amber, or crimson; those three hues strictly report live Engine power, UIPI risk, recording state, or validation outcome.

rules.name: The Compact Floor Rule
rules.body: Never drop any interactive label, caption, badge, or select option below `11px` anywhere in the popup; reserve `12px`+ for primary interactive row titles and buttons.

rules.name: The Tabular Stability Rule
rules.body: Keep `lining-nums tabular-nums` enabled globally so 2-second status polling updates never shift timestamps, coordinates, or volume readouts sideways.

rules.name: The No-Scroll Deck Rule
rules.body: Tab 1 and Tab 2 must operate comfortably within `520×580px` with zero vertical scrollbars in both Vietnamese and English locales; only Tab 3's dense key-binding matrix and dynamic conflict advisors use the viewport scrollbar.

rules.name: The Anchored Layer Rule
rules.body: Feedback banners and the Donate QR drawer render `position: absolute` `6px` (`bottom: 44px`) above the sticky footer (`z-index: 30` and `40`), never pushing grid geometry or shifting underlying buttons.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Rest cards stay flat on `#121826` over `#0B0F19` with `#232D42` `1px` borders, and nested controls step down into `#0E131F` inset wells; reserve real shadows exclusively for `z-index` floating overlays.

dos: Do preserve every DOM element ID verified by `tests/verify_i18n_and_ext_v5.py` and keep `i18n` labels wrapped inside `<span class="btn-label" data-i18n="...">` beside inline SVGs so runtime language switches never erase SVG icons.

Do validate every popup change across both `VI` and `EN` strings at fixed `520×580px`, ensuring zero ellipsis clipping on Horizon Strip descriptions, switch labels (`flex-wrap: wrap`), and compact `3×2` keycap slots.
Do keep every visual asset 100% bundled and MV3-CSP compliant (`1.75px` inline SVGs, local `.png`/`.jpg` assets, system font stack, zero `eval` or `innerHTML`).
donts: Don't reintroduce decorative emojis (`🚀`, `⚡`, `💤`, `✨`, `☕`) into popup headers, tabs, buttons, toggle labels, or `#popup-feedback` banners.
Don't collapse the popup back into a single-column scrolling stack (`< 480px`) or hide the bottom `Map Tabs` / voluntary `Support` footer behind scrolling.
Don't inject hard-coded local filesystem paths or unapproved MV3 host permissions anywhere inside `extension/` or design documentation.
